name: How do I choose the right contractor for my investment property renovation?
description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with experience in investment properties, strong references, clear bids, and good communication.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my investment property renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, prioritize experience with investment properties and a strong understanding of rental market needs. Look for contractors who are licensed, insured, and have positive references. Request detailed bids that clearly outline the scope of work, materials, timeline, and payment schedule. Compare multiple bids, not just on price, but also on the clarity of the proposal and the contractor's communication style. A reliable contractor will be transparent and responsive.
